title: Solomon’s Wives and Adversaries

questions.question: How many wives and concubines did Solomon have?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:3 (ESV): "He had 700 wives, who were princesses, and 300 concubines..."

questions.question: What did Solomon's wives do to him?
options: Turned away his heart after other gods
questions.correctAnswer: Turned away his heart after other gods
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:3-4 (ESV): "...And his wives turned away his heart. For when Solomon was old his wives turned away his heart after other gods..."

questions.question: Which god of the Ammonites did Solomon build a high place for?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:7 (ESV): "Then Solomon built a high place for Chemosh... and for Molech the abomination of the Ammonites..."

questions.question: What punishment did God pronounce on Solomon?
options: Tear the kingdom from him and give it to his servant
questions.correctAnswer: Tear the kingdom from him and give it to his servant
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:11 (ESV): "...I will surely tear the kingdom from you and will give it to your servant."

questions.question: For whose sake did God say He would not do this in Solomon's days?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:12 (ESV): "Yet for the sake of David your father I will not do it in your days..."

questions.question: Who was the first adversary God raised against Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:14 (ESV): "And the LORD raised up an adversary against Solomon, Hadad the Edomite."

questions.question: Who was the second adversary, who reigned in Damascus?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:23 (ESV): "God also raised up as an adversary to him, Rezon the son of Eliada..."

questions.question: Who was Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:26 (ESV): "Jeroboam the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite of Zeredah, a servant of Solomon..."

questions.question: What prophet met Jeroboam on the road?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:29 (ESV): "...the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite found him on the road..."

questions.question: How many pieces of the new garment did Ahijah give to Jeroboam?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:31 (ESV): "And he said to Jeroboam, 'Take for yourself ten pieces... I am about to tear the kingdom from the hand of Solomon and will give you ten tribes.'"

questions.question: How long did Solomon reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:42 (ESV): "And the time that Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years."

questions.question: Who was Hadad's wife?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:19 (ESV): "...so that he gave him in marriage the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen."

questions.question: What did Jeroboam do (his position) under Solomon before rebelling?
options: He was over all the forced labor of the house of Joseph
questions.correctAnswer: He was over all the forced labor of the house of Joseph
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:28 (ESV): "...appointed him over all the forced labor of the house of Joseph."

questions.question: Where did Jeroboam flee to escape Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:40 (ESV): "Solomon sought therefore to kill Jeroboam. But Jeroboam arose and fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt..."

questions.question: What city did Solomon build the Millo to repair?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:27 (ESV): "...Solomon built the Millo, and closed up the breach of the city of David his father."

key_verse_text: And the LORD was angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice (ESV)
